name: fhir-rust
summary: A Rust monorepo for the HL7® FHIR® standard: the data model, six relational database ports, and an HTTP surface over them.
trademarks: HL7®, and FHIR® are the registered trademarks of Health Level Seven International and their use of these trademarks does not constitute an endorsement by HL7.
notes: This is https://fhir-rust.github.io's copy of the monorepo's curated map: each entry's url resolves at this site's own page where one is published, and at the source repository (https://github.com/fhir-rust/fhir-rust) otherwise.

Four families compose one way only: model -> persistence core -> database ports -> HTTP surface. No family is normative for another; spec/index.md is the one place that says which specification governs which code.
R4.x is used by two unrelated requirement sets: fhir/spec/04-resources.md and spec/databases/04-shredding-and-reconstruction.md. Resolve a bare citation by the file it appears in.
